messages:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT ALERT — GPU capacity pressure detected in us-west-2 inference-pool at 2026-03-10T21:12Z. Latency SLOs degrading, paging dev-oncall and sre-amy.

dev-oncall: ack, joining. looking at autoscaler + pool status now.

sre-amy: seeing repeated scale_up failures in autoscaler logs. suspected provider quota/capacity. pulling logs.

infra-miguel: confirmed. provider returns InsufficientCapacity on p4d and a few p3 variants. Pool utilization ~92%, pending scale requests queued.

engops-raj: any immediate customer-visible errors?

product-lina: telemetry: ~12 customers with 95th latency >3s, 2 customers seeing 5xx spikes for generate calls. flagged on the dashboard.

customer-success-zoe: I've opened a quick update to the three largest affected accounts and added tracking in the CS spreadsheet. Will coordinate status messages once we have mitigation.

dev-oncall: quick mitigation plan — 1) enable cross-region overflow to eu-west-1 for non-enterprise routes, 2) evict or pause long-running batch jobs on the pool, 3) route small/short requests to a smaller-quantized model (q4) to reduce GPU footprint.

deploy-bot: Bridge created: #incident-2187654321-bridge (link)

infra-miguel: running eviction script now. command: ```bash
./scripts/evict-low-priority.sh --pool inference-pool --threshold 85
```

sre-amy: autoscaler error excerpt:
```
[2026-03-10T21:12:05Z] autoscaler: scale_up failed: QuotaExceeded: Requested gpus 8, available 0
[2026-03-10T21:12:12Z] autoscaler: retrying scale_up (attempt 2)
[2026-03-10T21:12:40Z] autoscaler: scale_up failed: InsufficientCapacity: Not enough p4d instances in us-west-2
```

engops-raj: can we fallback to CPU-backed instances for non-latency-critical batch jobs while we steady-state?

dev-oncall: yes, spinning up cpu-fallback groups for batch. also toggling routing policy: ```PATCH /routing/policies/overflow
{ "region_priority": ["us-west-2","eu-west-1"], "allow_overflow": true }
```

product-lina: prioritize enterprise customers on us-west-2 while overflow serves general traffic — need a quick ACL change.

pm-evan: noted — I'll own the ACL change and monitor product impact.

customer-success-zoe: sending an interim status to affected accounts now (no sensitive details, ETA 30m).

infra-miguel: eviction completed, freed ~10 GPUs. autoscaler retried and succeeded partially — scaled up 4 GPUs. latency improving but still above SLO for a subset.

sre-amy: monitoring metrics. will keep bridge open. logging all steps for post-incident.

dev-oncall: action log for immediate items:
- Evict low-priority batch jobs (done) — infra-miguel
- Enable cross-region overflow (done) — dev-oncall
- ACL to prioritize enterprise — pm-evan (in progress)
- CS notifications — customer-success-zoe (sent)

pm-evan: propose postmortem tomorrow 2026-03-11 10:00 PT, 1hr. Will capture timeline, RCA, and mitigation backlog. Anyone prefer different time?

engops-raj: fine. add 30min prep doc beforehand.

product-lina: add customer impact summary to the prep doc (who, where, duration).

dev-oncall: preliminary root cause hypothesis: cloud spot/ondemand availability dip in us-west-2 + autoscaler retry/backoff didn't surface faster fallbacks to smaller instance types. Need to confirm with provider logs.

infra-miguel: next steps (post-incident):
- Collect provider capacity responses and quotas (owner: infra-miguel) — JIRA INF-4821
- Add a fallback policy to autoscaler to allow different machine families (owner: dev-oncall) — JIRA INF-4822
- Improve routing policy test coverage for cross-region overflow (owner: engops-raj) — JIRA INF-4823
- Playbook update: eviction thresholds and preemptive batch pause (owner: sre-amy) — JIRA INF-4824

customer-success-zoe: audit the customer notifications and link to the postmortem doc in CS follow-up (owner: customer-success-zoe) — JIRA CS-317

sre-amy: tagging for severity: P2 (capacity, degraded SLOs, short duration). Will update incident ticket with final timeline and metrics.

dev-oncall: closing bridge once 95th latency under threshold for 30m. current 95th trending down.

deploy-bot: Bridge closed by dev-oncall at 2026-03-10T22:05Z.

pm-evan: added postmortem invite + doc link: https://docs.redwood.example/postmortems/INF-482-2026-03-10. Please add notes.

engops-raj: I will start the initial postmortem draft with timestamps and attach the autoscaler logs.

product-lina: let's schedule a short customer-facing note template postmortem once we have RCA. I'll draft.

sre-amy: follow-up timeline:
- T+24h: initial RCA draft (owners listed)
- T+48h: internal review and action prioritization
- T+7d: closure on INF-4821..4824 items or status update

dev-oncall: thanks everyone — good coordination. We'll run the postmortem and track remediation.

pm-evan: assigning owners in JIRA now, will ping those owners once assignments complete.

customer-success-zoe: leaving notes in CS for account owners. Will update when postmortem public note ready. :white_check_mark:

sre-amy: marking incident resolved in incident log. last_message recorded."
